newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police believe bomber among victims.
newsitem.headline: German police believe bomber among victims.

text.p: German police said on Wednesday they suspected one of the three women killed in a Christmas Eve bomb attack on a Protestant church in Frankfurt planted the bomb herself.

A police spokesman said that a woman who entered the church late after the Christmas Eve service had begun was now being considered a primary suspect in the attack that killed three and left 10 people seriously injured and three slightly hurt.
Earlier, Frankfurt police chief Wolfhard Hoffmann had denied reports that the bomber was among the victims.
Police had also said they were searching for a woman who witnesses reported seeing near the church with her face partially covered by a scarf.
The woman now suspected of planting the bomb entered the service late and took a seat near the rear of the church where the bomb exploded.

The woman's body was completely torn to shreds by the bomb. But police said the suspect's head, although severed from the body, had not been disfigured. They said they planned to photograph the suspect's face and distribute it to news media in hopes of obtaining clues from the public about her identity.
